# Global names that addon code may write without an MSUF prefix.
# Read by .github/scripts/msuf_static_checks.py (check_global_names).
# One exact name per line; `#` starts a comment. Every other non-MSUF,
# non-_G SETGLOBAL in the main/Options addons fails the static checks, so
# a new slash command or key binding needs its name added here on purpose.

# Key binding headers/names (Bindings.xml contract; read by Blizzard's
# KeyBindingFrame as globals).
BINDING_HEADER_MSUF_HEADER
BINDING_NAME_MSUF_PRIORITY_TOGGLE
BINDING_NAME_MSUF_TOGGLE_EDITMODE
BINDING_NAME_MSUF_TOGGLE_OPTIONS

# Slash command registrations (SLASH_<KEY><N> globals paired with
# SlashCmdList[<KEY>]).
SLASH_MIDNIGHTSUF1
SLASH_MSUF2OPTIONS1
SLASH_MSUFDBGPOS1
SLASH_MSUFOPTIONS1
SLASH_MSUFRELOADUI1
